title.en: Censuses of the 象 and 彖 against the places

statement.en: The 小象 sentences saying a line is 中 are of middle places, those saying its way is exhausted of the top place, those of a broken line carrying an unbroken one of rises, the 彖's 中正 of middle lines in phase; the sentences listed apart are not of these places.
statement.zh: 《小象》说一线为中者皆在中位，说其道穷亢者皆在上位，说柔承刚者皆是 rises，《彖》之中正皆是中而正之线；另列之句不在这些位。

laws.en: Forty-seven 小象 sentences saying a line is 中 are all of the second or fifth place; four other sentences with 中, not saying the line is, are of places that are not middle.
laws.zh: 说一线为中之 47 句皆在二或五；另 4 句含中而不说该线为中，其位皆不在中。

laws.en: Nine sentences saying a line's way is exhausted (窮, 亢) are all of the top place; five sentences with 窮 of will, trust or going are of lower places.
laws.zh: 说一线之道穷亢之 9 句皆在上位；另 5 句之窮说志、孚、往，皆在下位。

laws.en: Four sentences of a broken line carrying an unbroken one are each of a rise at their seam; eleven 彖 sentences that a line is 中正 are each of a middle line in phase; 恆九四 and 渙九五 agree with the phase of their lines.
laws.zh: 柔承刚之 4 句皆是其缝上之 rises；彖言中正之 11 句皆是中而正之线；恒九四与涣九五与其线之位相合。

hypotheses.en: No axiom; the sentences as listed from the texts in sources/zhouyi-yizhuan (the lists are the evidence, checked by evaluation).
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理；所列之句取自 sources/zhouyi-yizhuan 之文本（列表即证据，以求值检查）。

does_not_show.en: That the lists are complete beyond the texts read, or what the sentences judge.
does_not_show.zh: 列表在所读文本之外完备，或句之所断。

detail.zh: 其位、奇偶与缝即诸句所对。
